title: Helion Energy news rows
description: A light news list: a bracketed mono eyebrow, a tight two-line uppercase heading with a small intro and an outlined button beside it, then hairline-separated rows on a 12-column grid: headline with a mono date line, a 1.27 picture with 8px corners, a plus mark and summary, and a square arrow button bottom right. Phones stack each row. Pictures settle from 110% on arrival and a fill sweeps across each arrow button with the scroll.
notes: media is each row's picture; empty, a placeholder
